propositions: rebar-implement skill dispatch in Phase 4d lacks explicit model tier specification, causing subagents to inherit the expensive orchestrator model instead of delegating to cheaper tiers
skill documentation must define capability-tier mappings (strong/standard/cheap) with concrete Claude Code and Codex CLI examples to enable cost-aware delegation across different harnesses

Phase 3 non-code work (research, discovery, grep) and Phase 4a existing-coverage search should route to cheaper tiers, while test authoring (Phase 4b) and held-out validation (Phase 4e) must remain on strong tier to preserve TDD invariant
new 4e-bis escalation ladder must distinguish normal held-out iteration from model-weakness triggers without hardcoding module-size thresholds (defer to .github/module-size-limit.txt)
